-- models/stage/stg_orders.sql
-- Cleanse & cast raw order headers

with source as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."RAW"."raw_orders"

),

cleaned as (

    select
        order_id::integer                           as order_id,
        trim(customer_id)::text                     as customer_id,
        trim(store_id)::text                        as store_id,
        order_date::date                            as order_date,
        lower(trim(status))::text                   as order_status,
        coalesce(shipping_fee, 0)::numeric(12,2)    as shipping_fee,
        upper(trim(currency))::text                 as currency

    from source

),

-- Guard against duplicate order headers (e.g. order_id 1050 appears
-- twice in the raw feed) so the line-item fact does not fan out.
deduped as (

    select *
    from (
        select
            *,
            row_number() over (
                partition by order_id
                order by order_date desc
            ) as rn
        from cleaned
    ) ranked
    where rn = 1

)

select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    store_id,
    order_date,
    order_status,
    shipping_fee,
    currency
from deduped

-- models/dev/fct_order_items.sql
-- Line-level sales fact. Grain: one row per order item.



with order_items as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_order_items"

),

orders as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_orders"

),

products as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_products"

),

final as (

    select
        -- keys
        oi.order_item_id,
        oi.order_id,
        oi.product_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.store_id,
        o.order_date,
        o.order_status,

        -- quantities
        oi.quantity,
        oi.unit_price,
        oi.discount_pct,

        -- revenue measures
        (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)::numeric(12,2)                                     as gross_amount,
        (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * oi.discount_pct / 100)::numeric(12,2)             as discount_amount,
        
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0))
::numeric(12,2) as net_amount,

        -- cost & margin measures
        (oi.quantity * p.cost_price)::numeric(12,2)                                      as total_cost,
        (
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0))

            - oi.quantity * p.cost_price)::numeric(12,2)                                 as margin

    from order_items oi
    left join orders   o on oi.order_id   = o.order_id
    left join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id

)

select * from final

-- models/dev/fct_orders.sql
-- Order-header fact. Grain: one row per order.

with orders as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_orders"

),

items as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."DEV"."fct_order_items"

),

item_rollup as (

    select
        order_id,
        count(*)                    as num_line_items,
        sum(quantity)               as total_quantity,
        sum(gross_amount)           as gross_amount,
        sum(discount_amount)        as discount_amount,
        sum(net_amount)             as net_amount,
        sum(total_cost)             as total_cost,
        sum(margin)                 as product_margin

    from items
    group by 1

),

final as (

    select
        -- keys
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.store_id,
        o.order_date,
        o.order_status,

        -- measures
        coalesce(r.num_line_items, 0)                                   as num_line_items,
        coalesce(r.total_quantity, 0)                                   as total_quantity,
        coalesce(r.gross_amount, 0)::numeric(12,2)                      as gross_amount,
        coalesce(r.discount_amount, 0)::numeric(12,2)                   as discount_amount,
        coalesce(r.net_amount, 0)::numeric(12,2)                        as net_revenue,
        o.shipping_fee,
        (coalesce(r.net_amount, 0) + o.shipping_fee)::numeric(12,2)     as order_total,
        coalesce(r.total_cost, 0)::numeric(12,2)                        as total_cost,
        coalesce(r.product_margin, 0)::numeric(12,2)                    as product_margin

    from orders o
    left join item_rollup r on o.order_id = r.order_id

)

select * from final
